headline: Airbnb to Ban Hosts From Requiring Guests to Do Chores Under New Rules
summary: Airbnb hosts will be barred from asking guests to wash up or take out trash under new platform rules taking effect in November.
why: Airbnb is the world's largest short-term rental marketplace. Platform policy revisions can influence host retention, listing fees, and guest booking volumes.

impacts.name: Airbnb
impacts.why: New checkout chore restrictions could affect customer experience and host satisfaction on the platform.
